response.query: What budget line items and KPIs are essential now—equipment, storage, translation, personnel, repository fees—and what go/no-go thresholds and sustainability plans govern pilot scaling?
response.answer: Essential budget lines: equipment, storage, translation, personnel. KPIs: cost efficiency, scalability, sustainability. Go/no-go thresholds: 75% cost-effectiveness, 90% scalability, 80% sustainability compliance.
